response.justification: Despite a strong full-stack and open-source background, the candidate lacks direct C++ experience in industrial automation, secure development lifecycle (SDL), or IEC 62443 standards — core requirements for this role. Their recent work is dominated by TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, with only a brief, outdated C++ exposure from 2014–2015, insufficient for a senior C++ architect role.
strengths: Extensive experience in event-driven and distributed systems via GISCollective and DLang projects.
Strong track record in mentoring, workshops, and technical documentation.
Proven ability to work across stacks and deliver complex, real-world systems.
concerns: No recent or demonstrable C++/STL work in the last 9+ years; critical for the role.
Absence of industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443-4-1) or SDL implementation experience.
Lacks exposure to industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, MQTT) and on-prem/cloud automation platforms.
